name: Morioni
source:
Main character is a normal student, but one day he awakens in a strange forest. A demon-like existence with a horn leads him to the demon village. On the road a person appears who claims that protagonist is the "king" who is summoned to protect this world. Is there a way to get back to home world?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
